verdict.rationale: The Gemini API endpoint serves a machine-readable Google API Discovery document (REST description, HTTP 200 JSON) for the v1beta Gemini API. This is an OpenAPI-equivalent spec that users or agents can download programmatically. The probe's 404s concern llms.txt and MCP cards on the consumer app, not the API spec, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: a native OpenAPI-format file, first-party docs describing the spec download, independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidence beyond the v1beta version.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The Gemini API endpoint publishes a machine-readable Google API discovery document (equivalent of an OpenAPI spec), HTTP 200 JSON
